items.text: Nvidia previewed TensorRT Model Connect, converting supported Hugging Face models into end-to-end TensorRT inference with two commands.
items.text_zh: 英伟达发布 TensorRT Model Connect 预览版，只需两条命令即可将受支持的 Hugging Face 模型转为端到端 TensorRT 推理。

items.text: Pika detailed Soundtrack’s video-to-audio model, reporting strong temporal alignment and warm self-hosted generation averaging 0.617 seconds per video second.
items.text_zh: Pika 详解 Soundtrack 视频转音频模型，称其时间对齐表现突出，热启动自托管生成平均每秒视频耗时 0.617 秒。

items.text: Claude can now send Gmail messages and manage Google Drive files, with users retaining approval control over actions.
items.text_zh: Claude 现可发送 Gmail 邮件并管理 Google Drive 文件，具体操作仍由用户确认和控制。

items.text: Microsoft’s MAI-Image-2.6 Preview reached third place in Arena’s single-image editing leaderboard with 1,420 points.
items.text_zh: 微软 MAI-Image-2.6 预览版以 1420 分升至 Arena 单图编辑排行榜第三名。

items.text: HeyGen introduced Brand Kits for preset fonts, logos, colors and pronunciation guidance across avatar-generated content.
items.text_zh: HeyGen 推出 Brand Kits，可为数字人生成内容预设字体、标志、品牌颜色及产品名称发音规则。

items.text: Perplexity’s Computer agent now accepts tasks through email when users send, forward or copy messages to computer@perplexity.com.
items.text_zh: 用户现在可将邮件发送、转发或抄送至 computer@perplexity.com，直接通过邮件向 Perplexity Computer 智能体分派任务。

items.text: Vercel launched a $1 million challenge inviting researchers to escape its Firecracker-based Sandbox or break isolation boundaries.
items.text_zh: Vercel 发起百万美元挑战，邀请安全研究人员尝试逃逸其基于 Firecracker 的 Sandbox 或突破隔离边界。

items.text: Hugging Face’s model repository surpassed three million models, marking another milestone for its open AI ecosystem.
items.text_zh: Hugging Face 模型仓库突破 300 万个模型，成为其开放人工智能生态的又一里程碑。

items.text: Modular released the Mojo programming language as open source.
items.text_zh: Modular 将 Mojo 编程语言正式开源。

items.text: Mozilla updated Firefox Smart Window, an integrated AI assistant designed to maintain browsing context as users move between tasks.
items.text_zh: Mozilla 更新 Firefox Smart Window，这款内置人工智能助手可在用户切换任务时持续理解浏览上下文。

items.text: Synthefy raised $6.5 million to develop models trained specifically on numerical data rather than primarily on text.
items.text_zh: Synthefy 融资 650 万美元，用于开发主要以数值数据而非文本训练的模型。

items.text: Hypercubic raised $5.3 million for AI agents that map, understand and rewrite legacy COBOL applications.
items.text_zh: Hypercubic 融资 530 万美元，开发能够梳理、理解并重写传统 COBOL 应用的人工智能智能体。

items.text: Warp launched an out-of-the-box software factory intended to coordinate AI agents across application development workflows.
items.text_zh: Warp 推出开箱即用的软件工厂，用于在应用开发流程中协调多个人工智能智能体。

items.text: Stability AI introduced a plugin that brings Stable Audio 3.0 generation directly into music-production workflows.
items.text_zh: Stability AI 推出新插件，将 Stable Audio 3.0 生成功能直接带入音乐制作工作流。

items.text: MiniMax Design introduced an agent that turns brief instructions into complete design outputs without requiring extremely long prompts.
items.text_zh: MiniMax Design 推出设计智能体，可根据简短指令完成完整设计，无需编写数万字提示词。

items.text: A humanoid robot demonstrated what organizers described as the first fully autonomous complete table-tennis match at the 2026 World Robot Conference.
items.text_zh: 一款人形机器人在2026世界机器人大会上展示了主办方所称的全球首次全自主完整乒乓球对局。

items.text: Relativity Networks raised $22 million to commercialize faster fiber technology for increasingly bandwidth-intensive data centers.
items.text_zh: Relativity Networks 融资2200万美元，计划将面向高带宽数据中心的新型高速光纤技术商业化。

items.text: Tencent Hunyuan reported four new Hyra mathematical advances, including an improved universal lower bound for the three-dimensional Blaschke–Lebesgue problem.
items.text_zh: 腾讯混元公布 Hyra 的四项新数学进展，其中包括提高三维 Blaschke–Lebesgue 问题的通用下界。

items.text: Qdrant detailed how its filterable HNSW index preserves graph connectivity under filters instead of repairing filtered search only at query time.
items.text_zh: Qdrant 介绍其可过滤 HNSW 索引如何在过滤条件下保持图连通性，而非仅在查询阶段补救搜索。

items.text: MiniMax core engineering leader Adao has left the company after working on its large-scale agent infrastructure.
items.text_zh: 曾参与 MiniMax 大规模智能体基础设施建设的核心工程负责人阿岛已离职。

items.text: Lovart added Seedance 2.5, showcasing a prompt-driven colored-pencil video workflow that can produce a 30-second stylized clip.
items.text_zh: Lovart 接入 Seedance 2.5，并展示了用一句提示词生成30秒彩铅风格视频的工作流。

items.text: Kimi published a financial-analyst tutorial covering live investor dashboards, financial-model updates and another common investment-research workflow.
items.text_zh: Kimi 发布金融分析师教程，演示实时投资者看板、财务模型更新等三类常见投研工作流。

items.text: Alibaba’s Qwen3.8-27B ranked first among open-weight models on Harvey’s Legal Agent benchmark, according to Qwen.
items.text_zh: 据通义千问公布，Qwen3.8-27B 在 Harvey 法律智能体基准的开放权重模型中排名第一。

items.text: Qwen3.8-27B reached first place on Cline’s model leaderboard four days after its release, according to Qwen.
items.text_zh: 据通义千问公布，Qwen3.8-27B 发布四天后登上 Cline 模型排行榜首位。

items.text: Ollama began rolling out Moonshot AI’s Kimi K3 model to subscribers of its cloud service.
items.text_zh: Ollama 开始面向其云服务订阅用户逐步开放月之暗面 Kimi K3 模型。

items.text: Researchers proposed fail-closed runtime governance that verifies provenance and enforces controls whenever an AI agent crosses an action boundary.
items.text_zh: 研究人员提出默认拒绝执行的智能体运行时治理方案，在智能体跨越行动边界时核验来源并实施控制。

items.text: SkillEffect introduces checked lowering for agent tools, aiming to keep tool execution reliable when an AI agent has tightly constrained memory.
items.text_zh: SkillEffect 提出面向智能体工具的受检降级机制，旨在有限内存条件下维持工具执行的可靠性。

items.text: Google partnered with aviation organizations to use AI-assisted flight planning to reduce climate-warming aircraft contrails.
items.text_zh: 谷歌与航空业机构合作，利用人工智能辅助航班规划，减少会加剧气候变暖的飞机凝结尾迹。
